image_description: A close-up view of a baby bib against a solid yellow background. The bib is made of white terry cloth with a rounded neck hole and curved shoulder edges. The lower half features a large pocket or panel with a yellow and white floral/abstract pattern. A distinct yellow leaf-shaped appliqué is sewn onto the left side of the patterned area. The texture appears soft and absorbent.

artifact_observations.location: Yellow leaf appliqué on the lower left pocket
artifact_observations.reasoning: The yellow leaf shape appears slightly fused with the underlying patterned fabric. The stitching line is faint or missing, making it look like a printed graphic rather than a physically sewn-on patch. The texture of the leaf is also smoother and less defined than the surrounding terry cloth.
The inner edge of the neck hole is slightly irregular and blurry, lacking the crisp, reinforced hem typically found on real fabric bibs. It looks somewhat melted into the background.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and distinguish it from other clothing items like aprons or shirts.
To verify the physical connectivity of the leaf appliqué to the pocket and check for boundary bleeding between the bib and the yellow background.
To analyze the micro-texture of the terry cloth and the patterned pocket for signs of AI-generated smearing or inconsistent noise patterns.

focus_areas: Integrity of the leaf appliqué attachment (sewn vs. printed/fused)
Sharpness and realism of the terry cloth texture
Boundary separation between the white bib and the yellow background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'leaf' shape on the pocket. In AI images, appliqués often fail to cast shadows or show stitch lines, appearing instead as flat textures merged with the base layer. Also, verify if the terry cloth loops are consistent or if they dissolve into noise near the edges.
